label: Bible Study
prompt: And it came to pass, when the ark set forward, that Moses said, Rise up, LORD, and let thine enemies be _____; and let them that hate thee flee before thee.
verse: And it came to pass, when the ark set forward, that Moses said, Rise up, LORD, and let thine enemies be scattered; and let them that hate thee flee before thee.
note: Moses' marching prayer whenever the ark set out — David echoes it at the start of Psalm 68.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: The LORD is on my _____; I will not fear: what can man do unto me?
verse: The LORD is on my side; I will not fear: what can man do unto me?
note: The LORD is on my side; what can man do unto me? The question answers itself.

label: Sunday School
prompt: And she said, As the LORD thy God liveth, I have not a cake, but an handful of meal in a barrel, and a little oil in a cruse: and, behold, I am gathering two _____, that I may go in and dress it for me and my son, that we may eat it, and die.
verse: And she said, As the LORD thy God liveth, I have not a cake, but an handful of meal in a barrel, and a little oil in a cruse: and, behold, I am gathering two sticks, that I may go in and dress it for me and my son, that we may eat it, and die.
note: The widow had a handful of meal, a little oil, and two sticks for one last meal — then Elijah asked for the first cake.

label: Deep Water
prompt: And when the chief _____ shall appear, ye shall receive a crown of glory that fadeth not away.
verse: And when the chief Shepherd shall appear, ye shall receive a crown of glory that fadeth not away.
note: Peter, once told 'Feed my sheep,' reminds the elders that they serve under the chief Shepherd.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: And Philip ran thither to him, and heard him read the prophet Esaias, and said, _____ thou what thou readest?
verse: And Philip ran thither to him, and heard him read the prophet Esaias, and said, Understandest thou what thou readest?
note: Philip runs alongside the Ethiopian's chariot and opens with the best question in evangelism history.
